ICS 59.080.60TXD 04New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPE1.1 This standard specifies the constructional particulars and performance requirements of tufted artificial grass made from polypropylene fibrillated yarn, polyethylene monofilament yarn or combination of both.1.2 This standard does not specify the general appearance, design, size, etc. of artificial grass.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
